Wit (Wiimms ISO Tools)
======================

The launcher unpacks the disc image that the player selects by running the unmodified program wit.exe (a separate process, not linked into
the launcher). It is installed in the folder tools\wit next to the launcher together with the libraries it needs.

Program:  Wiimms ISO Tools v3.05a r8638, Windows (Cygwin 64-bit) build, https://wit.wiimm.de/
Licence:  GNU General Public License, version 2 or (at your option) any later version. The text is in gpl-2.0.txt.
Source:   the source code of this release is available in the SVN repository named in wit-source.txt
          and as a copy on https://github.com/Wiimm/wiimms-iso-tools

Libraries that come with the Windows build and are installed unchanged next to wit.exe:
  cygwin1.dll         Cygwin, https://cygwin.com/  (licence: https://cygwin.com/licensing.html, source: https://cygwin.com/git/newlib-cygwin.git)
  cygz.dll            zlib (zlib licence), https://zlib.net/
  cygcrypto-1.1.dll   OpenSSL 1.1 (OpenSSL licence), https://www.openssl.org/
  cygncursesw-10.dll  ncurses (X11 licence), https://invisible-island.net/ncurses/
The source packages of these libraries are published by the Cygwin project: https://cygwin.com/packages/

The port contains no game data. Wit only reads the disc image that the player owns.
